blocks.text: Migrations, communities abroad, integration, demography and social cohesion are themes present every day in the Arab press: in the countries of origin (the remittances, the flight of doctors and engineers, the relationship with communities abroad), in transit countries and in reception countries. They are also themes where words matter: ⁧مُهَاجِر⁩ , ⁧مُغْتَرِب⁩ , ⁧لَاجِئ⁩ and ⁧نَازِح⁩ are not synonymous; "irregular" and "illegal" do not say the same; The wave and flow transform people into water. In this unit you learn the vocabulary of migration and documents, that of society (demographics, inequalities, cohesion, discrimination) and above all to choose and translate words with precision and neutrality, taking up work on connotation (B2-11) and on humanitarian vocabulary (INT-04). Three weeks, in parallel with the end of MAG-01 and with MAG-02.
